senses.gloss: (headwear) A warm cloth cap worn while sleeping, often with pajamas, being common attire in northern Europe before effective home heating became widespread. [From 14th c.]
Inquisitiveness; the tendency to ask and learn about things by asking questions, investigating, or exploring.
An activity that one enjoys doing in one's spare time.
The quality of being inquisitive; curiosity.
An evening meal.
An optional light meal consumed shortly before going to bed.
The cardinal number occurring after eleven and before thirteen, represented in Arabic numerals as 12 and in Roman numerals as XII.
Still to be paid; owed as a debt.
Any of various echinoderms (not in fact fish) with usually five arms, many of which eat bivalves or corals by everting their stomach.
A textbook, a book used, or prepared for use, in school.
A military post stationed at a distance from the main body of troops.

An Italian variant of ice cream made from milk and sugar, combined with other flavourings. The ingredients are supercooled while stirring to break up ice crystals as they form.
A slick and light ship for making pleasure trips or racing on water, having sails but often motor-powered. At times used as a residence offshore on a dock.
To convey (a meaning).

A man who is bound in servitude.
A language spoken by the Slavey peoples.

Delicious.

An outer garment that covers the body from the waist downwards, covering each leg separately, usually as far as the ankles; trousers.

A long narrow inlet, or a strait between the mainland and an island; also, a strait connecting two seas, or connecting a sea or lake with the ocean.
An opening, road, or track, available for passing; especially, one through or over some dangerous or otherwise impracticable barrier such as a mountain range; a passageway; a defile; a ford.

To walk through water or something that impedes progress.

Describing a group or set with nine elements.
